entities.summary: Wilson Betemit is a Dominican former professional baseball infielder. He has played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Atlanta Braves, Los Angeles Dodgers, New York Yankees, Chicago White Sox, Kansas City Royals, Detroit Tigers, and Baltimore Orioles.
